name: The Deep Warrens
description: Councillor Asha mentioned Unbounded pathfinders using old maintenance tunnels beneath Meridian. If there's a peaceful faction beyond the Lighthouses, making contact could change the political calculus entirely.

descend_to_warrens.label: Find the Unbounded Contact
descend_to_warrens.description: Descend through the Meridian Undercity to the Deep Warrens. The Unbounded pathfinder is said to camp somewhere in the lower tunnels.

completionActions.text: Quest complete: The Deep Warrens. Pathfinder Ren is a contact worth keeping — the Unbounded are not the enemy the Council assumes.
